title: ActionBinding
description: Any binding descriptor an action can be rebound with — the second argument of ActionMap.rebind. Deliberately the union of every kind's descriptor rather than a conditional type resolved from the action being rebound. A conditional over the map's own type parameter, however written, stops TypeScript inferring that parameter at every OTHER `ActionMap<T>` site — `scene.inputs.attach(map)` included — so the precision would be paid for by breaking inference for every caller. The ACTION NAME is still checked against the map's declared actions, and a mismatched binding shape is rejected at runtime by the action itself.
